title: Mainframe Test Verification Technican ( Apprentice Conversion)
description: At IBM Infrastructure & Technology, we design and operate the systems that keep the world running. From high-resiliency mainframes and hybrid cloud platforms to networking, automation, and site reliability. Our teams ensure the performance, security, and scalability that clients and industries depend on every day. Working in Infrastructure & Technology means tackling complex challenges with curiosity and collaboration. You'll work with diverse technologies and colleagues worldwide to deliver resilient, future-ready solutions that power innovation. With continuous learning, career growth, and a supportive culture, IBM provides the opportunities to build expertise and shape the infrastructure that drives progress. As a Technician: Generalist, you will perform various technical activities in an engineering, scientific, or technological environment. Your role may involve working in different capacities such as Lab Technician, Electronic Technician, or Quality Technician, among others. Your primary responsibilities will include: • Debug and Inspection: Perform debugging and inspection tasks to identify and resolve issues with equipment, systems, or processes. This includes conducting tests and analyzing results to determine the root cause of problems. • Repair and Design: Carry out repair and design activities, including making occasional and uncomplicated deviations to existing designs or procedures. This requires experience in one main specialized activity and the ability to apply technical knowledge to resolve issues. • Testing and Quality Control: Conduct tests and inspections to ensure quality and reliability of equipment, systems, or processes. This involves applying technical knowledge and experience to identify and resolve quality-related issues. • Maintenance and Operations: Perform routine maintenance and operations tasks to ensure smooth functioning of equipment, systems, or processes. This includes monitoring performance, troubleshooting issues, and taking corrective action as needed. Successful completion of the IBM Apprenticeship Program • None United States Infrastructure & Technology Professional POUGHKEEPSIE, US POUGHKEEPSIE (0147) International Business Machines Corporation Completion Mainframe Computing

title: Digital Design Verification Engineering Intern
description: Change the world. Love your job. As a Digital IC Design Engineering intern, you'll architect new TI products and make our customers' visions a reality. You'll define, design, model, implement and document analog, digital, and RF integrated circuits (ICs). And, you'll have the opportunity to work in exciting areas like audio, imaging, high-speed, interface, clocking, medical, high volume linear, automotive, storage, power supply, battery management, linear power and many more. Some of your responsibilities will include, but will not be limited to: Partnering with business teams and system engineering to develop mutually agreeable design specifications Providing high-level analysis on chip architecture trade-offs to ensure spec compliance and superior performance at a competitive cost Participating in design reviews and creating the necessary design and product documentation Partnering on IC layouts to ensure a high-performance standard Characterizing prototypes, developing test specifications and coordinating with test/product engineering to drive product releases Driving behavioral models Put your talent to work with us as a Digital IC Design Engineer Intern ! Texas Instruments will not sponsor job applicants for visas or work authorization for this position. Minimum Requirements: Currently pursuing a Bachelors degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Technology, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology, Electrical and Computer Engineering or related field Cumulative 3.0/4.0 GPA or higher Preferred qualifications: Ability to establish strong relationships with key stakeholders critical to success, both internally and externally Strong verbal and written communication skills Ability to quickly ramp on new systems and processes Demonstrated strong interpersonal, analytical and problem-solving skills Ability to work in teams and collaborate effectively with people in different functions Ability to take the initiative and drive for results Strong time management skills that enable on-time project delivery Why TI? The future starts here. As a TIer, you'll play a critical role in defining the next era of semiconductor technology and help create the innovations that shape the world around us. Surround yourself with a team of innovators who value your unique perspective and will challenge you to bring your best self to work every day. We believe that fostering a culture of collaboration fuels both personal growth and technological breakthroughs. Explore our company culture . At TI, your success goes beyond your work. Take advantage of comprehensive benefits designed to support your total well-being at work and in life, from competitive compensation to extensive health coverage and wellness programs. Learn more about our benefits offerings . About Texas Instruments Texas Instruments Incorporated (Nasdaq: TXN) is a global semiconductor company that designs, manufactures and sells analog and embedded processing chips for markets such as industrial, automotive, data center, personal electronics and communications equipment. At our core, we have a passion to create a better world by making electronics more affordable through semiconductors. This passion is alive today as each generation of innovation builds upon the last to make our technology more reliable, more affordable and lower power, making it possible for semiconductors to go into electronics everywhere.
